questions.title: How to send crypto to Flash Transfer?
questions.content: To send crypto to Flash Transfer, simply log into your Flash Transfer account, select your desired cryptocurrency, specify the amount, and send it directly to the address provided by our platform. Flash Transfer instantly converts your cryptocurrency into stablecoins to avoid price fluctuations.

questions.title: Where can the Flash Transfer service be used?
questions.content: Flash Transfer can be used at over one million partner merchant locations across Europe, Africa, and Asia. Beneficiaries can conveniently collect cash or deposit funds directly into their mobile money accounts through these merchants.

questions.title: In which/how many countries does Flash Transfer operate?
questions.content: Flash Transfer operates extensively across Europe, Africa, and Asia, covering a wide network of countries. Our reach continues to expand as we partner with more local payment providers.

questions.title: How to convert your cryptocurrency to fiat?
questions.content: To convert your crypto to fiat, log in to your Flash Transfer account, select the "Crypto to Fiat" option, specify the cryptocurrency amount you wish to convert, and choose your preferred payout method and local partner (Orange Money, MTN, Wave, etc.). Your crypto is instantly converted to fiat currency and available at your chosen location.

questions.title: How to send cryptocurrency so that the beneficiary receives it in cash?
questions.content: To send cryptocurrency for cash pickup, simply choose the “Crypto-to-Cash” option in your Flash Transfer dashboard. Enter the recipient’s details, select a partner merchant location and local payment partner (Orange Money, MTN, Wave, etc.) where they can collect the cash, and send your crypto. The recipient can immediately withdraw the equivalent cash at the chosen partner location.

questions.title: Transaction fees
questions.content: Flash Transfer charges a clear, transparent fee of 2% per transaction, plus any local payment provider fees. All fees are displayed upfront before you confirm your transaction.
